exposure: CSP classification (low-risk vs. high-risk based on ultrasound)
outcome: pregnancy outcomes (live birth, uterine retention, pregnancy termination)
cohort: The study included 24 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) at a single hospital between 2015 and 2022.
finding: The study suggests that invasive placenta might be an outcome of CSP, and ultrasound-based classification of CSP could forecast pregnancy outcomes.
